## Instagram Reels Publisher (resumable upload)
Publishes a video as a **Reel** (and optionally the same file as a **Story**) without Meta having to download it from your server.

**Setup**
1. Create a **Facebook Graph API** credential (access token with `instagram_basic`, `instagram_content_publish`, `pages_read_engagement`).
2. Select it on every Facebook Graph API node **and** on *Upload Reel Video* / *Upload Story Video*.
3. Put your Instagram account ID into **Config** (`ig_user_id`).
4. Test: edit **Test Input**, run *Manual Test*.
5. **Publish** this workflow: in n8n 2.x, production runs of a caller use the published version (re-publish after edits).
6. Call it from other workflows with **Execute Sub-workflow** (see README).

### Input (first item only)
Video from **one** of: a binary property (`binary_property`, else `video`, `data` or the only one), `video_url` (downloaded by n8n) or `video_path` (inside `allowed_video_dir`, needs `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs`).

Options: `caption`, `share_to_feed` (default true), `also_story` (default false), `cover_url` **or** `thumb_offset` (ms).

### Reel: resumable upload
`POST /{ig-user-id}/media?media_type=REELS&upload_type=resumable` returns `{id, uri}` -> the bytes are POSTed to `uri` (rupload.facebook.com) with headers `offset: 0` and `file_size` -> poll `status_code` every `poll_interval_seconds` (keep it under 65 s so the run never leaves memory) -> `media_publish` -> permalink. ERROR / EXPIRED / timeout stop the run with Meta's status text.

### Story (optional, never breaks the reel)
The Graph API has no "share reel to story" option, so the same file is uploaded again as `media_type=STORIES` through the same resumable flow. Every failure here ends in **Story Result** as `story: {ok: false, error}`; the reel result is returned either way.
